# Vietnam Leader Seeks Deeper AI, Chip Cooperation with Japan

NEWS

Updated: Published:

Tokyo, Nov. 9 (Jiji Press)--Vietnam aims to deepen cooperation with Japan in sectors such as artificial intelligence and semiconductors, top Vietnamese leader To Lam said in a speech before the Diet, Japan's parliament, Monday. [...] Lam, general secretary of the Vietnam's Communist Party and president of the Southeast Asian country, said that his country wants to pursue a new path of development together with Japan.

He also said he hopes that the development of one side will expand opportunities for the other to make leaps forward, leading to regional peace, stability and prosperity. [...] Vietnamese leader To Lam delivers a speech at a plenary meeting of the House of Representatives at the Diet Building in Tokyo on Monday.

items.title: AI communications need to look beyond discovery
items.summary:
HCM CITY — Artificial intelligence (AI) can increase the speed and volume of content production, but relying on similar tools and outputs without a clear strategy risks making communications less distinctive and weakening a brand’s ability to stand out, experts said at a recent conference in HCM City.

The comments come as AI is adopted across sectors in Việt Nam, in line with Resolution 57 on breakthroughs in science and technology, innovation and national digital transformation. [...] Under Resolution 57, AI is identified as one of the strategic technologies that will play a decisive role in the country’s future development.

|  |

|  |
| Experts discuss about applying AI in communication sector at first OAC Regional Communications Forum 2026 in HCM City. — Photo courtesy of Ivy+Partners Vietnam | [...] For brands operating across Asia, including Việt Nam, expanding communications requires more than translating messages or using a uniform regional strategy. Different languages, cultures, media environments and consumer behaviours mean that a message seen as clear and credible in one market may be interpreted differently in another. AI systems can reflect or overlook these differences depending on the information and context available.

items.title: Top Vietnamese leader holds talks with Japanese PM
items.summary:
General Secretary and President Lam proposed establishing a network of scientists in six fields: robotics, semiconductor chips, energy technology, biotechnology, high-speed railways and quantum technology. PM Takaichi affirmed Japan’s commitment to actively support Vietnam, including by contributing to the country's plan to train 100 PhD holders in AI. [...] Vietnam and Japan are seeking to improve the quality and added value of cooperation. During Party General Secretary and President Lam’s visit, they are expected to promote collaboration in artificial intelligence (AI), small modular reactor (SMR) technology, nuclear power and human resource training, Nikkei Asia reported.

### See more [...] They also agreed to strengthen joint research projects, particularly in AI, and expand the NEXUS programme to provide more research opportunities for doctoral students in semiconductors and AI. The two sides will effectively implement 14 projects under the Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM).

items.title: FPT Proposes 5 Quantum-leap Ways To Boost Vietnam-Japan Tech Cooperation In 2026.
items.summary: This reflects the intent to move beyond simple knowledge transfer toward genuine joint development. FPT’s commitment to talent development is coupled with a broader strategy encompassing AI, quantum technology and technology financing. This approach aims to establish a sustainable and mutually beneficial relationship between Vietnam and Japan in the rapidly evolving field of AI and quantum computing. This strategy reflects a commitment to building a mutually beneficial relationship, ensuring [...] Connecting artificial intelligence facilities, data resources and application capabilities between Vietnam and Japan forms a core tenet of FPT’s proposed collaboration, with a key emphasis on maintaining domestic control over infrastructure and data for both nations. FPT’s vision, presented at the Vietnam-Japan Public-Private Forum, aims to facilitate data exchange and collaborative AI development while safeguarding national technological autonomy. A company statement released during the event [...] FPT is targeting specific industries for accelerated AI integration, focusing on automotive, electronics, logistics and energy sectors. The Vietnam-Japan Public-Private Forum on November 9 served as the venue for formalizing these ambitions, with FPT exchanging Memoranda of Understanding with Japanese partners to facilitate collaborative projects. These agreements aim to support a shared ecosystem for AI development and implementation.

items.title: We built Control Room, a central system to track model workloads across our research infrastructure and stop them quickl
items.summary:
We built Control Room, a central system to track model workloads across our research infrastructure and stop them quickly when safety or security concerns arise.

It connects every research inference workload, including agentic sampling for model training and evaluation, data processing, and more. This works together with our misalignment monitoring systems, and halts model output within 35 seconds of a decision to intervene to stop or pause a job.

Control Room is just one part of our holistic approach for safe frontier model training and deployment.

https://t.co/tc0lBqFdS5

items.title: A new way to measure how AI agents handle the routine analyses of wet-lab science—BioBasicsBench.
items.summary:
A new way to measure how AI agents handle the routine analyses of wet-lab science—BioBasicsBench.

Developed with Ligo, a biotech company focused on enzyme design, the benchmark draws on 100 tasks from real experiments to test whether agents can interpret raw lab data, identify errors, and recognize when the evidence doesn’t support a conclusion.

We built Control Room, a central system to track model workloads across our research infrastructure and stop them quickly when safety or security concerns arise.

It connects every research inference workload, including agentic sampling for model training and evaluation, data processing, and more. This works together with our misalignment monitoring systems, and halts model output within 35 seconds of a decision to intervene to stop or pause a job.

Control Room is just one part of our holistic approach for safe frontier model training and deployment.

items.summary:
A new way to measure how AI agents handle the routine analyses of wet-lab science—BioBasicsBench.

Developed with Ligo, a biotech company focused on enzyme design, the benchmark draws on 100 tasks from real experiments to test whether agents can interpret raw lab data, identify errors, and recognize when the evidence doesn’t support a conclusion.

Accelerating biological research starts with getting the everyday work right. BioBasicsBench shows where models need to improve, and helps us track what those gains mean for scientific progress, biosafety, and biosecurity.
